entities.summary: Almetyevsk is a city in Tatarstan, Russia, located on the left bank of the Zay River 265 kilometers (165 mi) southeast of Kazan. Population: 146,393 (2010 census); 140,437 (2002 census); 129,008 (1989 Soviet census); 77,000 (1969); 49,000 (1959).
